commands.label: Build the published native B compiler and standard library
commands.stdout:
cc -std=gnu99 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -g -O src/compiler/list.c src/compiler/main.c src/compiler/compiler.c -o bcause
cc -std=gnu99 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -g -O -nostdlib -c -Wno-incompatible-library-redeclaration -Wno-builtin-declaration-mismatch -ffreestanding -fno-stack-protector src/libb/libb.c -o libb.o
ar rv libb.a libb.o
a - libb.o
ranlib libb.a

commands.label: Read the compatible B compiler command options
commands.stdout:
Usage: ${SCRATCH}/049-fm2c722_/bcause-src/bcause [options] file...
Options:
-h --help    Display this information.
-v --version Display compiler version information.
-o <file>    Place the output into <file>.
-L<dir>      Location of B library.
-S           Compile only; do not assemble or link.
-c           Compile and assemble, but do not link.
--save-temps Do not delete intermediate files.

commands.label: Compile the original B greeting
commands.stdout:
as greeting.s -o greeting.o
ld -static -nostdlib greeting.o -L. -L/lib64 -L/usr/local/lib -lb -o greeting -z noexecstack
commands.stderr:
ld: cannot find -lb: No such file or directory
[1m[37m${SCRATCH}/049-fm2c722_/bcause-src/bcause: [1m[31merror: [0merror running linker (exit code 1)

commands.label: Compile against the published B standard library
commands.stdout:
as greeting.s -o greeting.o
ld -static -nostdlib greeting.o -L${SCRATCH}/049-fm2c722_/bcause-src -L/lib64 -L/usr/local/lib -lb -o greeting -z noexecstack
